about.description: Cross-pair FX perpetual on Gains Network tracking New Zealand Dollar / Canadian Dollar (NZDCAD), with pricing referencing Chainlink DON FX feeds. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC / DAI / WETH on Arbitrum / Polygon / Base, giving users synthetic exposure to the relative value of two foreign currencies without holding either as cash.
